architecture.title: Easy setup, no limitations
architecture.description: Building with Numos is simple - your vision grows, and we grow with you. Our modular platform lets you create collections that evolve and expand seamlessly, adapting to your journey and ideas every step of the way.

action.title: Interact with your asset
action.description: Make your asset fun with custom interactions. Trigger them with a simple click, token activity, or anything else.

traits.title: Change traits with actions
traits.description: Define unique traits that set your assets apart and make them dynamic through interactions.

image.title: Update the image via traits
image.description: The image brings your NFT to life, visually reflecting its traits. When traits change, the image updates automatically.

modular.title: Modular design
modular.description: We have big plans for the platform, so we designed it to be modular and easy to extend even for existing collections.

control.title: Keep control of your assets
control.description: We do not take ownership of your assets. You keep full control over your assets.
